notes.title: Changelog Version b.1.1.6
notes.notes:
NEW

General


Proximity interactions - Instead of using mouse to interact with object, move close and press F

Added confirm dialog on level exit when the SYMBOLS are not activated

Added 30s cd for each interactible encounter (void pearls, challange, ...) to avoid exploits and crashes

Added secret Contained Paradox item

Added proximity interactions to equip pickup

Added missing controls to settings controls tab

Added CD to description of equip items

Added new music track for tutorial

Added confirm dialog on level exit when the SYMBOLS are not activated

Soft Blade tower - updated visuals



Added simple map (hold R or middle mouse button)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528226/6acc1be4cf5225760d24de0e2416d39eb9f6c382.png"]


Balance


Rework: Synthetic Curse: "Attacks apply Synthetic Curse, that deals 5 % of Physical damage after 3 seconds. Subsequent hits GREATLY increase the damage dealt."

Mortar Tower and Ultimate Mortar tower - improved projectile spawn point



Fixes


Fixed possibility to be soft locked in tutorial

Drone stats displaying 1 for each stat

Interactibles in silver city to the new proximity interactions

Missile towers tageting of defense platform

Blood altars at Blood citadel not charging when the player is not around

Visual effect of laser attacks (minng laser beam, mining drone, laser tower, ...)

Fixed issue with sentient cannon perk in elemental system tree

notes.title: Changelog Version b.1.1.4
notes.notes:
NEW

General


 New sprites for for minibosses and T3 Towers
 Added stopwatch that shows time spent in a level
 Added camera speed setting
 Added pause in singleplayer only
 Screen notification on taking damage
 Added cooldown indication for skills and equipable items


 Blood Citadel

  Altars can be also charged by killing enemies
  Improved spawner location to spawn more enemies when charging the altar
  Improved objective texts
  Added vizual indication that altar is charged by killing enemies
  Enemies show small text with percentage charge added on death


 Silver City


  Improved objective texts and added names to the generators


 Defense platform


  Display arm names
  In phase 3, all arms spawn at once but with half HP
  Added HP indicator for pylons, increased pylon HP and armor


 Creator's core 


 Added HP bar for the KEEPER
 Adjusted HP and damage of the KEEPER


 Conflux 


 Added miniboss that drops core part


Balance


 Mining Laser: Lowered attack speed from 0,25 to 1 
 System trees: changed "Bonus projectile perk" to free locked Duplicator item


 Fixes 


 Fixed issue with duplication items on pickup
 Ancient Drone: Now correnctly scales it's damage by owner's physical damage
 Defense platform: Fixed scaling in multiplayer
 Creator's core: Fixed keeper scaling in multiplayer
 Silver city: Fixed energy reward in multiplayer
 Stalker: Fixed teleportation in multiplayer
 Fixed issue with sentient cannon perk in elemental system tree

notes.title: Changelog Version b.1.1.3
notes.notes:

 Purchased tower selection UI improved

 Improved the way of settings being saved
